Definition: Zecarjah, the name of twenty-nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zechariah is a name carried by twenty-nine men in the Old Testament, and the most famous of them is the prophet, the son of Berechiah, who preached to the returned exiles alongside Haggai and saw the visions of the lampstand and the flying scroll. Another Zechariah, the son of the priest Jehoiada, stood up in the court of the temple and was stoned for telling Judah it had forsaken the LORD. Ezra names the prophet again when the rebuilding of the temple resumes, because his preaching is what moved the work forward.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name itself is the message, because Zechariah means the LORD remembers, and every Zechariah in the book stands under that promise. God remembers His people, His covenant, and His temple, and He raises up men with that very name to say so.
RelatedPeople: Zechariah the Prophet; Haggai; Ezra; Zerubbabel
